neighboring_unit_entries.title: Prime number theorem from zero-freeness, and zero-freeness back from PNT
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Applies Wiener-Ikehara to the von Mangoldt transform using zeta's sole boundary pole and zero-free line, then reverses the logic by showing a PNT error transform cannot have a pole at 1+it.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: Euler-product positivity excludes boundary zeros, positive-coefficient singularity principles diagnose forbidden continuation, and Tauberian positivity turns the surviving pole into prime-counting asymptotics.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: The Tauberian conclusion also uses monotonicity and exact analytic boundary hypotheses, not positivity alone.
related_synthesis_entries.title: Positivity at the boundary is the bridge to primes
